analysis.headline: Outlets split on whether Yandex drone strikes caused Russian bot-traffic collapse
analysis.summary: Ukrainian drone strikes on Yandex data centers knocked cloud and payment services offline, with network connectivity reported at about 30% of normal. One outlet reported that bot traffic collapsed because of the strikes, while another said the outage probably was not actually behind the drop in Russian bot activity.
